learnLanguage.title: Learn a language abroad
learnLanguage.subtitle: Find a language program by age group, destination, and study length
learnLanguage.intro1: Thinking about learning a language abroad? Immersion lets you practice around the clock and experience culture firsthand.
learnLanguage.intro2: Education Interntions helps you choose the right country, duration, and level — with advisors supporting you from planning to departure.
learnLanguage.empty: No programs for this age group
learnLanguage.findByAge: Find a program for your age group
learnLanguage.deepdive1Body: Language travel is more than new vocabulary. You build confidence, friendships, and a broader worldview. Education Interntions helps you pick the destination, language, and length that match your goals.
learnLanguage.deepdive2Title: It’s never too late to start
learnLanguage.deepdive2Body: Language learning takes time — but living in the language speeds progress. Whether you want a short course or a longer stay, Education Interntions has options for every stage of life.
learnLanguage.why1: End-to-end advisors from course choice to departure day
learnLanguage.why2: A trusted network of universities and language schools
learnLanguage.why3: IELTS and pathway planning aligned to your goals
learnLanguage.why5: Close support on documents, visas, and pre-departure prep

academicYear.metaDescription: Long-term language immersion abroad with Education Interntions — 2–4 terms, global destinations, end-to-end advisor support
academicYear.heroTitle: Become fluent in the city of your dreams
academicYear.heroBody: Build real fluency while living like a local — with culture immersion and life skills that prepare you for university and global careers.
academicYear.promoBanner: Language study + life abroad for ages 16+ | About 6 months – 1 year
academicYear.whyTitle: Why students love studying with Education Interntions
academicYear.usp1Body: Become fluent in language and local culture while building a global network of friends
academicYear.usp2Body: Start your path to university or a dream career — study 2, 3, or 4 terms and earn a certificate of language progress
academicYear.usp3Body: Study on a timetable that fits you, with tuition, housing, and activities designed as a complete package
academicYear.usp4Body: Grow through an overseas experience and gain life skills that set you up for the future
academicYear.offerTitle: Check our latest offers and promotions
academicYear.whereTitle: Where do you want to go?
academicYear.whereBody: Discover a new country and live like a local. Choose the destination that matches your goals with Education Interntions.
academicYear.goalsBody: Build language and cultural fluency with programs tailored to your goals — career-focused or university-bound.
academicYear.track1Body: Intensive language progress with campus life and activities
academicYear.track2Body: Pathway planning for overseas universities with academic and language support
academicYear.track3Body: Prepare for language exams or build skills for an international career
academicYear.termsBody: Each term builds on the last — so you keep progressing whether you study for 2, 3, or 4 terms.
academicYear.term1a: Build a strong language base through interactive lessons and interest-based classes
academicYear.term1b: Live like a local with activities and support from the Education Interntions team
academicYear.term2a: Grow life skills such as communication, creativity, and cross-cultural adaptability
academicYear.term2b: Connect with the community through clubs, events, and volunteer opportunities
academicYear.term3a: Apply your skills in a final project that showcases what you’ve achieved
academicYear.term3b: Celebrate your progress with a certificate and confidence for the next step
academicYear.termsNote: 2 terms ≈ 6 months · 3 terms ≈ 9 months · 4 terms ≈ 11 months (including prep periods depending on the program)
academicYear.nextBody: Book a call with a Education Interntions advisor or request more information to plan the right Academic Year for you.
academicYear.eventsBody: Learn more about our programs at an online or in-person session with a Education Interntions advisor.
academicYear.eventsNext: See upcoming sessions on the events page
academicYear.faqBody: Find answers to common questions — or contact us. The Education Interntions team is ready to help.
academicYear.faq1Q: Who is Academic Year best for?
academicYear.faq1A: Anyone who wants serious language progress abroad and a pathway toward university or a global career — typically ages 16+.
academicYear.faq2Q: What does a typical week look like?
academicYear.faq2A: Expect about 4–5 hours of class per day, plus cultural and social activities. Weekends are great for exploring the city.
academicYear.faq3A: The term structure and immersion approach help you progress step by step, with certificates and assessments depending on the program.
academicYear.faq4Q: What do I receive when I finish?
academicYear.faq4A: A certificate of achievement from the school/program, and possibly exam certificates or extras depending on your package.
academicYear.faq5A: Typically 2 terms ≈ 6 months, 3 terms ≈ 9 months, 4 terms ≈ 11 months — start dates depend on the destination.
academicYear.faq6Q: What if I feel homesick or nervous?
academicYear.faq6A: Education Interntions and on-site staff support you throughout. You’ll have activities, peer connections, and guidance while you settle in.
